system.description:
Deal [(SR+1)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target, and the target takes [Weakness (Physical): [INT mod]]. This weakness is handled as Life Status with the [Sealed] tag, and it continues until the target consumes 2 [Fate Points] or until the start of your next main process.

A special skill that inflicts pain that cracks the target's fighting spirit and deprives them of their concentration.
